name: Glyphic Tablet
summary: In the Valley of Trials, Gornek gives the Glyphic Tablet to novice Darkspear troll mages. Its summons sends them to Mai'ah for instruction in arcane magic.

sections.title: A Mage's First Summons
sections.body: New Darkspear initiates with an affinity for arcane power receive the Glyphic Tablet in the Valley of Trials. Gornek passes it to young recruits as they handle early tasks around the red canyons. On the slate, Mai'ah, a seasoned troll mage outside the Den, invites them to meet her. The Darkspear follow arcane traditions unlike the scholarly academies of humans or high elves. Mai'ah offers instruction and a solemn warning: raw magic corrupts and deceives, and its dangers to a mage's mind exceed those of any enemy soldier.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Glyphic Tablet?
aliases: why do i have glyphic tablet
faq.answer: The Glyphic Tablet summons a novice troll mage to Mai'ah in the Valley of Trials for proper spellcasting training.
Mai'ah writes the tablet, and Gornek hands it to young troll recruits in the Valley of Trials.

faq.q: Why do troll mages need a warning about magic?
faq.answer: Mai'ah warns that arcane magic corrupts, feeds arrogance, and can make spellcasters feel invincible. Its unseen dangers are deadlier than physical rivals.

faq.q: Can other Horde races receive this tablet?
faq.answer: Troll mages receive the Glyphic Tablet in the Valley of Trials. Orc mages receive a Glyphic Parchment summoning them to Mai'ah.

angles.text: As a mage, you begin your Darkspear arcane instruction with Mai'ah's warning that magic's corrupting allure is your greatest peril.
As a Darkspear troll, you receive this tablet to begin your path alongside traditional shamanic and martial ways.
